stem: A system shows rising root-zone EC while irrigation-in EC is stable and drainage volume has fallen. What is the strongest next interpretation step?
choices: Review water/solute inputs, drainage, root-zone trend and delivery uniformity together before changing formulation
Assume the source-water lab is wrong
Ignore drainage because feed EC is stable
rationale: Mass-balance reasoning requires integrating what enters, leaves and accumulates. Stable feed EC does not rule out reduced drainage, distribution issues or root-zone accumulation.
